terrainPiece.area: single polygon points in local space (clockwise or counter-clockwise is fine, just be consistent)
terrainPiece.areas: optional array of polygons when a piece has multiple shapes
terrainPiece.walls: array of wall segments in local space; each segment is either [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] or {type, segment}
terrainPiece.wallTypes: type can be heavy, light, or door
